model.limits: This model shows a few possible feeding connections, not every species or every meal on Guam’s reefs. Arrows point from food toward the eater to show energy transfer. Sunlight is an energy source, not an organism. Real food webs branch, change, include decomposers and can have other energy sources; this sunlit example leaves most of that out.

model.limits: These are possible changes, not a required circle or a weather forecast. Real water can stay in one store for a long time, take other routes, move in many places at once and pass through plants. Invisible water vapor is a gas; visible cloud droplets are liquid or ice. The drawing is not to scale and does not show safe drinking water.

model.limits: This is an invented sky model, not tonight’s view from Guam, a star finder or a navigation tool. Dots, distances and brightness are symbolic; connecting lines are imagined. Earth’s rotation changes the view over a night, its orbit changes seasonal views, and location changes the visible sky. No Sun-looking or outdoor activity is needed.
